verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page offers an org-level option to keep data out of AI model training, arranged through an account manager (otter-docs-43). A community report says Otter's privacy statement discloses training on 'anonymized' recordings (otter-comm-6), which fits a train-by-default posture with an enterprise opt-out rather than contradicting it. Audit trails and logging are claimed for compliance reporting (otter-docs-20), but the pack has no evidence of SOC 2 or HIPAA posture. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA documentation, a self-serve or technically enforced opt-out control (it currently requires contacting an account manager), detailed first-party training-data policy docs, and independent corroboration.
